mapper.select: SELECT isch.inbound_schedule_id, isch.product_id, isch.warehouse_id, isch.schedule_qty, isch.schedule_date, isch.status, isch.version FROM inbound_schedules AS isch WHERE isch.inbound_schedule_id = #{inboundScheduleId} AND isch.company_id = #{companyId} AND isch.version = #{version};

SELECT isch.inbound_schedule_id, proc.product_code, proc.name AS product_name, proc.product_id, isch.warehouse_id, isch.schedule_qty, isch.schedule_date, isch.status, isch.version FROM inbound_schedules AS isch JOIN products AS proc ON isch.company_id = proc.company_id AND isch.product_id = proc.product_id WHERE isch.inbound_schedule_id = #{inboundScheduleId} AND isch.company_id = #{companyId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_schedules( company_id, product_id, warehouse_id, schedule_qty, schedule_date, status ) VALUES( #{companyId}, #{productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{scheduleQty}, #{scheduleDate}, #{status} )
